    • getMaximumNormalizedBranchProfileDifference

      public double getMaximumNormalizedBranchProfileDifference(String firstName, String secondName, String branchName, TwoFluidPipeNetworkRefinementStudy.ProfileQuantity quantity)
      Compare complete final branch profiles on both cases' physical cell-centre positions.

      Each profile is linearly interpolated onto the other mesh and the larger absolute difference is normalized by the largest magnitude present in either result. This symmetric measure avoids selecting one mesh as the hidden reference and remains dimensionless for every supported quantity.

      Parameters:
      firstName - first case
      secondName - second case
      branchName - branch name
      quantity - profile quantity
      Returns:
      symmetric maximum normalized profile difference

    • getSpatialConvergenceReport

      public TwoFluidPipeNetworkRefinementStudy.SpatialConvergenceReport getSpatialConvergenceReport(String coarseName, String mediumName, String fineName, String branchName, TwoFluidPipeNetworkRefinementStudy.ProfileQuantity quantity)
      Quantify monotonic three-grid spatial convergence for one branch quantity.

      The three cases must differ only in spatial resolution: outer time steps and explicit branch-subcycle maps must match, branch lengths must be unchanged, section counts must increase, and the two refinement ratios must be equal. The receipt uses symmetric common-position maximum discrepancies, an observed order p = ln(e_coarse-medium / e_medium-fine) / ln(r), and the conventional three-grid fine-grid convergence index 1.25 e_medium-fine / (r^p - 1). Non-monotonic and roundoff-limited sequences remain explicit receipts with no finite convergence index, so callers cannot mistake them for accepted error estimates.

      Parameters:
      coarseName - coarsest-mesh case
      mediumName - intermediate-mesh case
      fineName - finest-mesh case
      branchName - branch to compare
      quantity - profile quantity
      Returns:
      immutable three-grid convergence receipt
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if cases are confounded, grids are not equally refined or discrepancies are not finite
